prompt: A clean claim under Medicare generally means:

options.text: Complete, accurate, timely submission with no missing info
Accepted by the clearinghouse, even if payer edits flag errors
Paid in full at the billed charge on first submission
Submitted within 12 months even if the NPI is missing

explanation: Clean claims contain all data needed for adjudication without additional information. Required identifiers such as the NPI must be present.

distractorExplanations.b: Clearinghouse acceptance only passes format edits; a clean claim must also pass payer edits without needing more information.
distractorExplanations.c: Clean means processable without extra information; payment is made at the allowed amount, not the billed charge.
distractorExplanations.d: Meeting the 12-month filing limit does not make a claim clean when a required identifier like the NPI is missing.
